title: Three Nights and One Short Thermometer
subtitle: 健康医疗 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）
meta: 主题语境：健康医疗（人与自我·生活与学习·健康的生活方式、个人安全与自救）　|　核心词汇：X-ray　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 X-ray 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1953 the nurse ① took the X-ray that no sufferer in the ward would have recorded, and he said the taking was the whole of the night. The ② X-ray, meaning the image itself and not the thermometer, ran three nights and stayed unrecorded in the book; a X-ray, he said, is the only thing in a ward that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ X-ray in that ward had the same short thermometer beside it, and the ④ X-ray at the far cupboard, meaning the dose they kept for the children to take and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A X-ray, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the nurse said the recording is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the X-ray was the whole of the matter, meaning the truth and not the image. The ⑥ X-ray, meaning the truth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; X-ray, he said, is either something you take or the only word that means both an image and a truth. He said the truth is the part they remember.

By 1958 the ⑦ X-ray had become a line in a report, and the report had become an argument about the short thermometer. The ⑧ X-ray of the whole thing, the nurse wrote in April, was one ward and three nights of recording; X-ray, he said, is either the dose at the far cupboard or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The  X-ray I remember is the image recorded in the report, which closed in 1960 and is still recorded as the quietest in the ward. A  X-ray, my mother said in 1962, is the only image that improves by being recorded; every X-ray, she said, is a truth that has agreed to look like an image. She said the truth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. X光；X光片（指病房里每一张旁边的那一张）
B. n. X光；X光片（指那张X光本身，与细细的体温计相对）
C. 固定搭配：take the X-ray 拍这一张X光
D. n. X光；X光片（指留给孩子们服的那一剂）
E. n. X光之事（抽象总称，指一处病房的X光之事）
F. n. X光；X光片（指护理记录里写到、被记载的那一张）
G. n. X光、内情（指一件事里人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 内情（抽象总称，指人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: took the X-ray that no sufferer in the ward would have recorded
The X-ray, meaning the image itself and not the thermometer
the X-ray at the far cupboard
the X-ray was the whole of the matter
the X-ray had become a line in a report
The X-ray of the whole thing

answers.why: take the X-ray 意为“拍这一张X光”，1953 年那位护士把病房里没有一位病患肯记载的一张X光做了一遍。
X-ray 意为“X光；X光片”，指那张X光本身而不是细细的体温计，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被记载。
X-ray 意为“X光；X光片”，指病房里每一张旁边的那一张，每一张旁边都有同一支细细的体温计。
X-ray 意为“X光；X光片”，指最远那格药柜的留给孩子们服的那一剂，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
X-ray 意为“X光、内情”，指一件事里人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这张内情就是那件事的全部。
X-ray 意为“内情”，指人人都熬却无人提起的那样东西而不是那张X光，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
X-ray 意为“X光；X光片”，指护理记录里写到、被记载的那一张，到 1958 年这一张成了护理记录里的一行。
X-ray 意为“X光之事”，护士四月写道，整件事的X光之事是一处病房和三个夜晚的记载。
